register.name: Rejestr-BDO
register.operator: Ministry of Climate and Environment / marshal offices
register.notes: Portal fetched live 2026-08-16 (blocks some bots; reachable). BDO number must be obtained before trading and shown on invoices and waste documents. 2026 registration/annual fee: 200 PLN for micro-enterprises, 800 PLN for others (raised from 100/300 PLN; annual fee due by 28 February, non-payment leads to removal — confirmed on the Mazovia marshal office BIP notice). Annual fee is waived in the year the registration fee is paid.

notes: Rates intentionally null: Polish recovery organisations (organizacje odzysku) price by individual contract and publish no official tariff table; Rekopol site (fetched 2026-08-16) lists a 'dopłaty' service but no rates. Polish packaging EPR reform (ROP / new packaging act, draft UC100) still in progress as of Aug 2026 — re-check scheme landscape when the act passes.
